name: NotebookLM
description: Enterprise edition of Google's NotebookLM (now branded Gemini Notebook Enterprise) for AI-assisted research over uploaded source documents, exposed as a preview REST API under Gemini Enterprise / Vertex AI Discovery Engine.
auth_methods: OAuth2 (Google Cloud IAM / gcloud bearer token)
gating_notes: No self-serve API key for the consumer NotebookLM product. The API only exists under Gemini Notebook Enterprise, which requires an admin to set up a Google Cloud project, purchase/assign Gemini Notebook Enterprise licenses, and grant the 'Cloud NotebookLM User' IAM role. The API itself is in Preview / Pre-GA status.
mcp_notes: No official or well-known MCP server found; Google positions access through Gemini Enterprise agent tooling rather than a standalone MCP integration.
blocker: Requires customer-owned GCP project with Gemini Notebook Enterprise licensing and admin-configured IAM/OAuth before any API call works; no consumer-level self-serve credential exists, and the API is still Preview/Pre-GA.

name: Otter.ai
description: AI meeting transcription and notes platform with a public REST API and an official MCP server for surfacing meeting transcripts/insights to AI assistants.
gating_notes: Any user can generate an API key from Integrations > Developer tab in their Otter.ai account (limit of 2 keys per user); no sales/approval process found.
mcp_notes: Otter publishes an official 'Otter MCP Server' documented in its help center for connecting meeting transcripts/search into Claude and other MCP clients; separate unofficial community MCP servers also exist (some using email/password login instead of the API key).

name: Fathom
description: AI meeting recorder/notetaker offering a public REST API (meeting summaries, transcripts, action items), OAuth2, webhooks, TS/Python SDKs, and an MCP server.
gating_notes: Developer docs at developers.fathom.ai state anyone can browse docs, generate an API key, and start building immediately; 60 requests/min rate limit applies to all API keys.
mcp_notes: Fathom's developer hub explicitly lists an MCP server for AI assistants alongside the REST API and webhooks.

name: Consensus
description: AI-powered research search engine over 220M+ academic papers, offered as a ChatGPT/Claude App via one-click OAuth and as a V2 developer API with OAuth2, plus an official 'Consensus AI Connect' MCP server.
gating_notes: The ChatGPT/Claude App integration is self-serve one-click OAuth via the Apps directory. The underlying V2 REST API and OAuth client registration are documented through a support-portal PDF/guide rather than an open public signup flow, suggesting some developer onboarding friction versus a fully open API console.
mcp_notes: Official 'Consensus AI Connect' MCP server hosted at mcp.goconsensus.com/mcp using OAuth2 with PKCE; also distributed as a ChatGPT App.

name: Reducto
description: Document parsing and extraction API that converts PDFs, scans, and other complex documents (30+ file types) into structured, LLM-ready data via classification, parsing, extraction, splitting, editing, and multi-step pipelines.
gating_notes: Docs advertise a 5-minute quickstart to parse a first document; Enterprise tier adds dedicated field engineering and custom fine-tuning but is not required for base API access.
mcp_notes: No official or well-known MCP server found in Reducto's documentation during this research pass.

name: Devin
description: Autonomous AI software engineer from Cognition with a session-based REST API and an official hosted MCP server for driving Devin sessions from other AI tools.
auth_methods: Org-scoped service user keys with X-Org-Id header
gating_notes: API/MCP access requires a paid Devin plan (personal or org/enterprise); enterprise service-user and PAT keys need org admin provisioning and an X-Org-Id header, though no sales conversation is strictly required to start on a paid self-serve plan.
mcp_notes: Official Devin MCP server hosted at mcp.devin.ai/mcp, using the same API-key auth as the REST API; also a separate CLI-focused MCP overview at cli.devin.ai.

name: higgsfield
description: AI content generation suite (image, video, audio/voice, 3D, marketing/shorts studios, website builder, social publishing) exposed via a REST API, official CLI, SDKs, and an extensive MCP tool surface.
auth_methods: Browser-based login for CLI (higgsfield auth login)
gating_notes: Users generate their own API key from the Higgsfield dashboard; CLI installs via npm and authenticates through a browser login flow. Usage is credit/plan-based but signup itself is self-serve.
mcp_notes: Higgsfield has an extensive, actively maintained MCP tool surface (image/video/audio/3D generation, marketing studio, website builder, TikTok publishing, voice cloning, scene building, etc.) confirmed directly via a live Higgsfield MCP integration; this is one of the most complete MCP surfaces among the researched apps.

name: Mermaid CLI
description: Open-source command-line tool (mmdc) that renders Mermaid diagram definitions (including those embedded in Markdown) into SVG/PNG/PDF, backed by Node.js and Puppeteer.
gating_notes: Free, open-source; install via npm, Docker/Podman, or npx. No account, key, or auth of any kind — it runs entirely locally.
mcp_notes: No official MCP server from the mermaid-cli project itself; various unrelated third-party 'mermaid diagram' MCP servers exist in the community but none are the official CLI wrapped as MCP.
blocker: There is no hosted API or auth model to integrate against — it is a local CLI/Node library requiring a Puppeteer/Chromium runtime. A Composio toolkit would need to shell out to the CLI (or embed the Node API) rather than call a remote endpoint, which is a fundamentally different integration pattern than the rest of Composio's toolkits.

name: YouTube Transcript
description: Third-party REST API (TranscriptAPI.com) for fetching YouTube video transcripts plus search, channel, and playlist metadata, with built-in MCP integration guides.
gating_notes: Self-serve signup with a credits/billing system; no approval or sales process evident.
mcp_notes: Site documents MCP setup guides for ChatGPT, Claude, and OpenAI Agent Builder, indicating a first-party MCP integration path alongside the raw REST API.

name: Grain
description: AI meeting recording, transcription, and note-taking platform with a REST API supporting personal, workspace, and OAuth2 app integrations.
gating_notes: Personal API access requires a Starter, Business, or Enterprise paid plan; Workspace API access requires Business/Enterprise plus admin access to generate a workspace token. OAuth2 app registration is available for building integrations used by any Grain user.
mcp_notes: No official or well-known MCP server found for Grain during this research pass.
